embeds.title: PSBL TRADE DISCUSSION
embeds.description: Open talk about trade ideas, valuations and strategy.

fields.name: USE THIS ROOM FOR
fields.value: Negotiating • Comparing offers • Rebuild vs. contend strategy • Pick valuations

fields.name: TRADE RULES
fields.value: Trades are unlimited and are not subject to a league vote. The deadline is the end of Week 20 and trading reopens the day after the World Series ends (Article XI). Future 1st- and 2nd-round pick trades require prepayment (Article XII).

fields.name: OFFICIAL RECORD
fields.value: A trade is official only when it is processed in Fantrax. Posts here don't bind anyone.
